our_interpretation: The immediate antecedent is Cognition, Perplexity, Cursor, Lovable, Cohere, Replit and Glean.

The ordinary reading is substantial whole-company losses and no financially credible route to whole-company profitability for each company. Positive gross margins alone do not establish profitability.
Use July–September 2025, the latest completed calendar quarter before publication, as the reporting window for the ongoing loss claim. The companies do not necessarily share reporting calendars.
Assess the profitability-path statement using business economics and plans applicable to that period. Later profitability cannot automatically establish what was knowable then.
The passage supplies no accounting basis or numerical definition of substantial losses.
